text:
inc-bot: ALERT — paging delivery failed for notify-relay (service) :rotating_light: 3 attempts, last_error=403 signature_mismatch. root_ts=1765432109

dina: saw the alert, can someone confirm if oncall got paged?

ben: nothing in PagerDuty for that window. no incoming webhook logs on PD side.

alice: I didn't get a ping on phone or slack. I was oncall at that time.

inc-bot: delivery logs from relay: 
```
POST /webhook/pager 403 {"reason":"signature_mismatch","sig_header":"v1=abc123..."}
```

ben: looks like our signing key rotated yesterday during deploy. relay still using old key.

mel: confirmable — I see signing-rotation job succeeded but notify-relay config didn't pick up new secret: env var NOTIFY_SIGNING_KEY unchanged on rolling pods.

dina: immediate mitigation: flip to fallback route to sms-gateway for critical pages. ben can you run the emergency route flip?

ben: on it. running: `./ops/runbook route-fallback --service notify-relay --to sms-gw --reason "signing mismatch"`

ben: route flip done, phone pages now flowing, sending a test page to alice.

sre-oncall: test received on phone, loud. good. please keep PD alerts on while we troubleshoot.

alice: got the test. thanks. did we assess customer impact? any missed customer pages?

mel: quick scan of last 30m: two customer-facing alert groups for ingest-egress saw increased latency but no persistent failures. no support tickets opened yet.

dina: filing customer impact note: "Potential missed operator page window due to webhook signing rotation mismatch; fallback to SMS activated at 1765432175; no confirmed customer incidents, monitoring continues."

ben: root cause: rotation job updated KMS but the config-provider sidecar didn't restart because of liveness probe flapping. adding restart to fix.

inc-bot: action item created: INC-2026 — ensure post-rotation restart of notify-relay pods; owner=ben; severity=medium; ETA=30m.

dina: quick patch: rolling restart of notify-relay deployed, verifying env now contains new key. `kubectl rollout restart deployment/notify-relay --namespace=prod`.

mel: pods restarted, signing header now 200 on webhook sends. logs show success.

dina: leaving fallback route in place for 15m to validate, then will revert if stable.

alice: thumbs up. please update runbook to include post-rotation restart step — I can PR after incident wrap.

ben: noted. I'll add a test that verifies PD receives at least one test page after rotation.

inc-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: fallback active -> sms-gw at 1765432175; notify-relay restart at 1765432250; pages restored at 1765432270.

sre-oncall: monitoring will keep a 5m cadence for next 60m. if no regressions, mark resolved.

dina: thanks all. I'll draft postmortem and link INC-2026 to runbook changes. :white_check_mark:
